<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>UAIX.Browser.Memory</id>
    <version>0.1.8</version>
    <title>TinyRustLM / UAIX Browser Memory SDK</title>
    <authors>TinyRustLM maintainers</authors>
    <requireLicenseAcceptance>true</requireLicenseAcceptance>
    <license type="file">LICENSE.txt</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://aka.ms/deprecateLicenseUrl</licenseUrl>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://tinyrustlm.com/</projectUrl>
    <description>Public TinyRustLM .NET SDK for UAIX.org .uai AI memory packages, AI Memory Package Wizard workflows, discoverable setup catalog, embedded AI digest adoption, point-agent setup URLs, prompt nudges, Safe Structured Output review boundaries, review/export checks, Codex/Claude/GPT agent-use blocks, DTMI policy, family-aware required files, file handoff, LLM Wiki memory layouts, multi-agent communication records, Talisman System anchor-governance review records, and advanced persona personality-pack validation. It plans required files including agent-pickup.uai, session-log.uai, manifest JSON, manifest overlay, package model, knowledge graph, llms.uai, and llms-full.uai exports; inspects .uai folders, .zip and .uaix archives without extraction; inspects memory manifest JSON; and reports advanced persona .uaix, ZIP, and TXT deck expectations plus dimension evidence for depth_level_0_to_10, disclosure boundaries, source confidence, triggered style axes, and non-inference rules for TinyRustLM runtime consumers. This package backs the UAIX.Browser.Memory local feed identity while keeping hosted import validation, automatic repository writes, automatic LLM Wiki sync, persona-fidelity certification, memory ranking, and private optimization logic out of the package.</description>
    <releaseNotes>Protected public SDK surface for .slm validation, runtime harness operations with SDK/ABI version query, managed/native generation-option validation, embedded-NUL string-boundary validation, empty-string native bridge preservation, managed share-kit request validation, managed P2P JSON byte-budget preflight, UAIX memory/persona package validation, native-backed UAIX setup catalog discovery, UAIX multi-agent memory planning, UAIX Talisman System package planning, workspace rustfmt/clippy release gates, declared package-file audit gates, package documentation hash parity audit, exact package-set audit, package identity audit, package metadata policy audit, public dependency graph audit, dependency metadata policy audit, native asset placement audit, native asset filename audit, package entry allow-list audit, public API surface audit, binary public surface gate, publish-plan source provenance gate, and typed metadata-bound P2P workflows with direct announcement URL validation, local signed-manifest verification, local piece verification, local assembly, typed share-kit and share-metadata records, announcement JSON handoff helpers, catalog inspection with byte-budget enforcement, raw JSON audit handoff, and receipt-sidecar inspection. Private conversion, authoring, training, routing, telemetry, and licensing internals are intentionally excluded.</releaseNotes>
    <copyright>Copyright TinyRustLM maintainers</copyright>
    <tags>TinyRustLM TinyRustLM.Memory TinyRustLM.com UAIX UAIX.org UAIX.Browser Browser UAIX.Browser.Memory UAI .uai .uaix memory ai-memory AI-Memory-Package-Wizard ai-digest point-agent-urls prompt-nudges canonical-starter-zip safe-structured-output review-export-checks agent-use-blocks dtmi-policy family-aware-required-files agent-pickup session-log manifest-json manifest-overlay package-model knowledge-graph llms.uai persona advanced-persona personality-packs persona-deck triggered-style-axes depth_level_0_to_10 source-confidence non-inference LLM-Wiki file-handoff multi-agent agent-communication talisman talisman-system SLM .slm AI LLM Rust runtime-harness protected-sdk</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://TinyRustLM.com/" commit="6f6b917888fb4fbc90a77fe5a68b65b73d7189a0" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net8.0">
        <dependency id="UAIX.Browser.Core.Abstractions" version="0.1.8" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="UAIX.Browser.p2pLLM.Runtime" version="0.1.8" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
